name: Fleetwide Mem20 + A2A Setup
description: Network-wide rollout: every bot gets isolated mem20 namespace, A2A inter-bot communication, and decision persistence. Crash recovery without session hunting.

phases.name: Phase 1: Rename releasecoach → coach (directory + SOUL header)
Phase 2: Enable A2A on all 18 profiles (platform_toolsets or config)
Phase 3: Add mem20 MCP to all profile configs (13 profiles missing it)
Phase 4: Create isolated mem20 namespace for each bot
Phase 5: Add fleetwide rule: every bot stores decisions to mem20 immediately
Phase 6: Test — crash a bot, verify resume from mem20 without session search
